quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and capex (DART half-year report filed 08-13-2026): heavy-industries production capacity (parent + Nantong + Pune + Memphis, valued at average selling price) KRW 1,894,093M for H1 2026 against actual output KRW 1,979,213M = UTILISATION 104.49% (FY2025 104.15%, FY2024 102.37%) - plants running above nameplate for a third year. Parent capex H1 2026 KRW 94,589M vs KRW 48,323M in H1 2025, of which new-build/expansion KRW 69,252M against a plan of only KRW 5,242M (pulled forward); consolidated PP&E purchases KRW 167,939M vs KRW 70,432M; construction-in-progress KRW 272,339M at 2026-06-30 vs KRW 137,259M at 2025-12-31. Hyosung HICO (Memphis, USA) has two expansion programmes in progress: USD 67,160K (2025-01 to 2026-12; test lab and equipment; USD 31,132K spent, USD 36,029K to go) and USD 180,114K (2025-07 to 2028-06; USD 50,622K spent, USD 129,492K to go) - the 'large-scale Memphis UHV transformer plant expansion (USD 157M)' announced Q4 2025. Other capacity: HVDC transformer plant groundbreaking (Q3 2025); Changwon export circuit-breaker plant and total KRW 100B investment (Q3 2025); Nantong 50GVA capacity expansion (2025); Changwon UHV transformer test lab extension (Q2 2025). June 2026: Hyosung HICO signed a JV with a Quanta Services subsidiary to form HYOSUNG HICO BREAKER, LLC (51% Hyosung, KRW 25,085M invested, gas circuit breaker manufacturing in the US). RAW MATERIALS H1 2026: steel plate KRW 39,801M (suppliers POSCO, Samdong, TC Materials), copper KRW 94,090M; domestic electrolytic copper price KRW 19,386-21,575/kg vs KRW 13,432-17,727/kg in 2025 and KRW 11,366-14,185/kg in 2024 (rising in Q2 on sulphur supply and FX). Hyosung HICO imports copper, core steel and steel and is building a local US/Mexico supply chain; HICO America flags US trade-regulation risk for Changwon and Nantong exports, mitigated by the US production base. Headcount 3,614 (power PU 1,815).

quarterly_data.signal: Pipeline and events (DART half-year report filed 08-13-2026): the filing names DATA CENTERS as a new growth engine combining power equipment, ARMOUR+ AI asset-management and construction capability 'with overseas partners'; Q2 2026 'STT Seoul 1' data center opened (Hyosung STT GDC associate, 40% owned, KRW 16,800M added in H1, KRW 314,700M guarantee to Gasan Landmark Data Center PFV); charter already includes data-center construction/leasing. Q2 2026 firsts: Korea's first 145kV 49kA GIS (vacuum interrupter) for European offshore wind, first 145kV dry-air circuit breaker, MOUs with Vietnam Electricity (grid stabilisation, first HV motor plant in Vietnam), long-term transformer/reactor supply agreement with AusNet (Australia), Hyosung HICO Breaker JV with Quanta Services. Q1 2026: cumulative UHV transformer output passed KRW 10T, first Korean spring-operated 362kV GCB, e-STATCOM MOU with Skeleton and Marubeni, IEC 62443-4-1 security certification, ~KRW 787B power-equipment contract with a US transmission operator, first Australian ESS order KRW 142.5B. R&D: SF6-free 145kV 40kA GIS, North-American 362kV 63kA and 245kV 63kA GCBs, MMC STATCOM wins, 4.2MW modular PCS with KPX 500MW long-duration BESS orders, JET certification for Japan, 400kV eco-oil transformer as main supplier to UK National Grid, phase-shifting transformer for Transgrid, 345kV eco-oil and variable reactors for KEPCO, ITER transformer, 100% hydrogen engine generator. Ratings upgraded 03-30-2026: corporate bond A+ (from A0) and CP A2+ (from A2) by Korea Investors Service, CP A2+ by NICE 04-03-2026. Auditor changed to Samil PwC (designated, 2026-2028). Share price avg KRW 2,191,190 (Jan 2026) to KRW 3,518,571 (Jun 2026), TSR 145.8% YTD. Risks: KFTC 170kV GIS bid-rigging fine KRW 11,237M under appeal, KEPCO bid-participation ban stayed 08-20-2025; fatal crane accident at Gangwon wind site 05-08-2026.
